results.scenario: Compare recent and preceding 30 day counts

service_a.scenario: Compare recent and preceding 30 day counts
service_a.sql:
SELECT
    t.CUS_NUM,
    COUNT(CASE
            WHEN t.TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
             AND t.TRA_DATE <  TRUNC(SYSDATE)
            THEN 1
        END) AS RECENT_30D_TXN_CNT,
    COUNT(CASE
            WHEN t.TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 60
             AND t.TRA_DATE <  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
            THEN 1
        END) AS PRECEDING_30D_TXN_CNT
FROM BI_DWH.PIO_TRANSACTIONS t
GROUP BY t.CUS_NUM
HAVING COUNT(CASE
            WHEN t.TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
             AND t.TRA_DATE <  TRUNC(SYSDATE)
            THEN 1
        END) >
       COUNT(CASE
            WHEN t.TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 60
             AND t.TRA_DATE <  TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
            THEN 1
        END)

service_b.scenario: Compare recent and preceding 30 day counts
service_b.sql:
SELECT t.CUS_NUM,
       t.current_count,
       t.baseline_count,
       (t.current_count - t.baseline_count) AS count_diff
FROM (
  SELECT CUS_NUM,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - :cs_b1 + 1 AND TRA_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN 1 END) AS current_count,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN TRA_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (:cs_b1 + :cs_b2) AND TRA_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) - :cs_b2 THEN 1 END) AS baseline_count
  FROM BI_DWH.PIO_TRANSACTIONS
  GROUP BY CUS_NUM
) t
ORDER BY t.CUS_NUM;
